final: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) AS player_total FROM college_counts), shares AS (SELECT player_count, player_count * 1.0 / player_total AS share FROM college_counts CROSS JOIN total), average AS (SELECT AVG(player_count) AS average_count FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT player_count, share, player_count - average_count AS difference FROM shares CROSS JOIN average WHERE player_count > average_count) SELECT AVG(player_count), AVG(share), AVG(difference) FROM kept
